description: This file defines an object CanvasActionTrust that manages canvas action URLs, including verification and normalization logic for trusted URLs within an Android application.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a given URL is trusted based on predefined criteria and a list of trusted URLs.

methods.name: matchesTrustedRemoteA2uiUrlExact
methods.description: Determines if a candidate URI exactly matches a trusted URL after normalization.

methods.name: normalizeTrustedRemoteA2uiUri
methods.description: Normalizes a URI to a canonical form for comparison, ensuring scheme and host case-insensitive matching.

methods.name: parseUri
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a URI object, returning null if parsing fails.
